English: This paper explores the number and characterization of latent classes of adverse childhood experiences across the Evidence for Better Lives Study cohort and investigates how the various typologies link to prenatal substance use (i.e., smoking, alcohol, and illicit drugs) and poor infant outcomes (i.e., infant prematurity and low birth weight).
Luganda: Olupapula luno lutunuulira omuwendo n’enfaanana z’ebibinja ebyawuzi eby’ebintu ebibi ennyo abaana bye bayitamu mu buto mu Kunoonyereza Okwoleka Obulumu Obulungiko era ne kwekenneenya engeri ebika eby’enjawulo gye bwekwanya ku nkozesa y’abazadde ey’ebidagala (kwe kugamba, okunywa sigala, omwenge, n’ebidagala ebirala) n’enkula y’abaana embi (kwe kugamba abaana abazaalibwa nga tebannatuuka n’abaana abazaalibwa nga tebazitowa kimala).
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí ṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò iye àti àbùdá ìpín àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n dojúkọ àwọn ìrírí ìgbà èwe káàkiri ẹ̀rí fún iṣẹìwadìí ajẹmọ́ ìgbé ayé ìrọ̀rùn fún ìdá àwọn wọ̀nyí àti láti ṣe ìwádìí  bí oníruurú àwọn ohun ìṣokùnfà ìlò àwọn ohun olóro nínú oyún (bíi, fífa ohun olóro, mímú ọtí líle, àti ìlò àwọn ògùn olóro) àti àbájáde àwọn aròbó tí kò dápé (bíi aròbó tí kò tọ́jọ́ àti ibi ọmọ ti kò gbé ìwọ̀n tí ó tọ́).

Hausa: Wannan takarda ta binciki adadi da halayen ɓoyayyun azuzuwan mutane da munanan abubuwa suka faru da su a lokacin ƙuruciya a cikin ƙungiyar Nazarin Shaida don Ingantacciyar Rayuwa kuma ta bincika yadda nau’o’in suke da alaƙa da amfani da abubuwan shaye-shaye kafin haihuwa (watau shan taba da barasa da haramtattun ƙwayoyi) da kuma ƙarancin sakamakon jarirai (watau haihuwar bakwaini da rashin nauyin haihuwa).

English: Latent class analysis using the Bolck, Croon, and Hagenaars (BCH) 3-step method with auxiliary multilevel logistic regressions with distal outcomes were performed.

Yoruba: Ìlò ọgbọ́n ìṣàtúpalẹ̀ ajẹmọ́ ìpín àwọn ènìyàn kan láwùjọ nípa lílo tí ó ní ṣe àmúlò Block, Croon, àti Hagenaars (BCH)-ìgbésẹ̀ 3 pẹ̀lú olùrànlọ́wọ́ ọlọ́pọ̀ ìpele àwòṣe aṣàpèjúwe ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn  àbájáde tí ó jìnnà ni wọ́n ṣe.

Hausa: An gudanar da nazarin ɓoyayyen aji ta amfani da hanyar mataki 3 na Bolck da Croon da kuma Hagenaars (BCH) tare da sanin bayanai a hannu na koma bayan shirin matakai da yawa tare da sakamako mai nisa.

Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tšeo di sekasekile diphere tše 1200 tša mma le lesea ka go dinaga tše 8 tša letseno la fase le la magareng (di-LMIC), go akaretšwa Ghana, Afrika Borwa, le Pakistan.
Amharic: ጥናቱ ጋና፣ ደቡብ አፍሪካ እና ፓኪስታንን ጨምሮ፣ 1200 የሚጠጉ የእናት-ልጅ ጥንዶችን በ8 ዝቅተኛ- እና መካከለኛ-ገቢ ባላቸው አገሮች (ኤል.ኤም.ኤም.አይ.ሲዎች) ውስጥ ገምግሟል።

English: They had the mothers answer questions about how they might have been abused when young, any substances they may currently use, and their baby's health.
Luganda: Baabuuza bamaama ne baanukula ebibuuzo nga balaba oba nga baatulugunyizibwako nga bato, ebidagala bye bayinza okuba nga bakozesa mu kiseera kino, n’obulamu bw’abaana baabwe.

Hausa: Sun sa iyaye mata su amsa tambayoyi game da yadda wataƙila aka iya cin zarafin su lokacin da suke ƙanana, duk wani abun shaye-shaye da za su iya amfani da su a halin yanzu, da kuma lafiyar jaririnsu.
Northern Sotho: Ba kgopetše boma go araba dipotšišo ka ga ka fao ba ka bego ba tlaišitšwe ge ba be ba sa le ba bannyane, diokobatšidife goba dife tšeo ba ka bego ba di šomiša mo lebakeng, le maphelo a lesea la bona.
Amharic: እናቶች በወጣትነት ጊዜያቸው እንዴት ጥቃት ሊደርስባቸው እንደሚችል፣ በአሁኑ ጊዜ ሊጠቀሙ ስለሚችሉት ማንኛውም ንጥረ ነገሮች፣ እና የልጃቸው ጤና ላይ ለሚነሱ ጥያቄዎች መልስ እንዲሰጡ አደረጉ።

Luganda: Abanoonyereza abo ate olwo ne bakozesa omutetenkanyirizo oguyitibwa “Latent Class Analysis” (Okwekaliriza kw’Ebibinja Ebyawusi) okubinjawaza emigogo gy’abamaama okusinziira ku kwanukula kwabwe.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí wọ̀nyí wá ṣe àmúlò òdiwọ̀n tí a pè ní Ìlò ọgbọ́n ìṣàtúpalẹ̀ ajẹmọ́ ìpín àwọn ènìyàn kan láwùjọ láti pín àwọn ìyá-lọ́mọ wọ̀n yí sí ìsòrí tí ó bá ìdáhùn wọn mu.
Zulu: Laba bacwaningi babe sebesebenzisa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi “Latent Class Analysis” ukuze bahlukanise ngababili umama nengane ngokwezimpendulo zabo.

Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba go tloga fao ba ile ba šomiša mokgwa wo o bitšwago “Tshekatsheko ya Legoro leo le Iphihlilego” go hlatha diphere tša mma le lesea go lebeletšwe dikarabo tša bona.

Luganda: 1) abatulugunyizibwa ennyo, 2) abatulugunyizibwa mu birowoozo ne mu mubiri, 3) abatulugunyizibwa mu birowoozo, ne 4) abatulugunyizibwa ekitono.

Zulu: 1) ukuhlukunyezwa kakhulu, 2) ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzwelo nangokwenyama, 3) ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzwelo, kanye 4) nokuhlukunyezwa okuphansi.

English: The researchers said 7% of the mothers were highly abused, 13% were emotionally and physically abused, 40% were emotionally abused, and 40% experienced little to no abuse.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti ebitundu 7% ekyabamaama baali batulugunyizibwa nnyo, ebitundu 13% baali batulugunyizibwa mu birowoozo ne mu mubiri, 40% baali batulugunyizibwa mu birowoozo, ne 40% baali batulugunyizibwa kitono oba nga tebatulugunyizibwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí sọ pé ìdá 7% àwọn ìyá ni wọ́n ti kọjú àṣìlò tí ó burújáì, ìdá 13% jẹ ìya ìmọ̀sílára ati ti ìyà ara, ìdá 40% ti jìya ìmọ̀sílára nìkan, àti ìdá 40% ni wọn kò ni ìṣòro àìdúró dééde ilé àti ìkọjú ìyà tí ó pọ̀ púpọ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe isi-7% somama bahlukunyezwa kakhulu, i-13% lahlukunyezwa ngokomzwelo nasemzimbeni, ama-40% lahlukunyezwa ngokomzwelo, kanti ama-40% lwabhekana nokuhlukunyezwa okuncane kakhulu, ukuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi emindenini yabo beseyizingane.
Hausa: Masu bincike sun ce kashi 7% na iyaye mata sun kasance waɗanda aka ci zarafin su sosai, kashi 13% sun kasance waɗanda aka ci zarafi na zuciya da kuma jiki, kashi 40% an ci zarafin su na jiki, kuma kashi 40% sun fuskanci cin zarafi kaɗan.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore 7% ya boma ba tlaišitšwe kudu, 13% ba tlaišitšwe maikutlong le mebeleng, 40% e tlaišitšwe maikutlong, gomme 40% e itemogetše tlaišo goba ya hloka tlaišo.

English: Many mothers in the highly abused group saw and experienced physical, emotional, and sexual abuse within their families as children.
Luganda: Bamaama bangi mu kibinja ky’abatulugunyizibwa ennyo baalaba era ne bayita mu kutulugunyizibwa okw’omubiri, mu birozoowo n’okwegatta mu maka gaabwe nga bato.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ìyá ọlọ́mọ ní ìpín àwọn tí wọ́n ti kọjú àṣìlò tí ó burújáì ni wọ́n ti rí tí wọ́n sì ní ìrírí ìyà ara, ìyà ìmọ̀sílára àti ti ìfipabánilòpọ̀ láàárín ẹbí wọ́n ní ìgbà tí wọ́n wà ní ọmọdé.
Zulu: Abaningi eqenjini elihlukunyezwe ngokomzwelo nasemzimbeni nabo babona futhi babhekana nokuhlukunyezwa ngamazwi nasemzimbeni phakathi kwemindeni yabo beseyizingane.
Hausa: Yawancin iyaye mata a cikin rukunin da aka zalunta sosai sun gani kuma sun fuskanci cin zarafin jiki da zuciya da kuma na cin zarafin jima'i a cikin iyalansu tun suna yara.
Northern Sotho: Bomma ba bantši ka sehlopheng seo se tlaišitšwego kudu ba bone le go itemogela tlaišo ya mmeleng, ya maikutlo le ya thobalano ka malapeng a gabo bona ge ba sa le bana.

English: Many in the emotionally and physically abused group also saw and experienced verbal and physical abuse within their families as children.
Luganda: Bangi mu kibinja ky’abatulugunyizibwa mu birowoozo ne mu mubiri era baalaba era ne bayita mu kutulugunyizibwa okw’ebigambo ne mu mubiri mu maka gaabwe nga bato.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn tí wọ́n wà ní ìpín àwọn tí ìyà ìmọ̀sílára àti ara ti jẹ bákan náà ti kọjú èébú àti ìyà ara láàárín àwọn ẹbí wọn ní ìgbà tí wọ́n wà ní ọmọdé.

Northern Sotho: Ba bantši ka sehlopheng sa ba go tlaišwa maikutlong le mmeleng le bona ba bone le go itemogela tlaišo ya go rogwa le ya mmeleng ka malapeng a bona e sa le bana.

English: In the emotionally abused group, many saw a family member verbally abuse another.
Luganda: Mu kibinja ky’abatulugunyizibwa mu birowoozo, bangi baalaba omu ku bafamire ng’atulugunya omulala ng’akozesa ebigambo.
Yoruba: Ní ìpín àwọn tí wọ́n ti kọjú ìjìyà ìmọ̀sílára, ọ̀pọ̀ wọn ni wọ́n ti rí àwọn mọ̀lẹ́bí wọ́n tí wọ́n fi ìyà jẹ́ mọ̀lẹ́bi mìíràn.

Northern Sotho: Ka go sehlopha sa go tlaišwa maikutlong, ba bantši ba bone le leloko la lapa le roga yo mongwe ka lapeng.

English: The 3 groups that experienced abuse were more likely to use illegal drugs.
Luganda: Ebibinja 3 ebyayita mu kutulugunyizibwa byalina emikisa mingiko okukozesa ebidagala ebitakkirizibwa.
Yoruba: Ó ṣe é ṣe fú àwọn Ìpín 3 tí wọ́n ti kọjú ìlòòdì wọ̀nyí ṣe àmúlò ògùn olóró.
Zulu: Amaqembu ama-3 ahlukunyeziwe maningi amathuba okuthi asebenzise izidakamizwa ezingekho emthethweni.

Northern Sotho: Dihlopha tše 3 tšeo di itekogetšego tlaišo go be go na le kgonagalo ye kgolo ya gore ba ka šomiša dikokobatši tšeo di sego molaong.

Yoruba: Ohun tí í ṣe ni ní kàyéfi ni pé, àwọn ìpín tí wọ́n tí kọjú ìyà ìmọ̀sílára àti ìyà ara níkan ni wọ́n fi àmì pé ọmọ wọ́n le è kéré púpọ̀ ní ìwọ̀n hàn.
Zulu: Kuyathakazelisa, ukuthi iqembu elihlukunyezwe ngokomzwelo nasemzimbeni kuphela elibonise izimpawu zokuthi izingane zabo ezisanda kuzalwa zingase zibe nesisindo esiphansi sokuzalwa.

Northern Sotho: Seo se kgahlišago, ke gore ke fela sehlopha seo se bego se tlaišwa maikutlobg le mmeleng seo se laeditšego maswao a gore maseao a bona ao a sa tšwago go belegwa a na le boima bja afse ge a belegwa.

English: This may be the first study to focus on LMICs for this topic.
Luganda: Kuno kwe kunoonyereza okulabika nga kwe kusoose okutunuulira LMICs ku nsonga eno.
Yoruba: Èyí le è jẹ́ iṣẹ́ ìwadìí àkọ́kọ́ láti dojúkọ LMICs fún kókó yìí.
Zulu: Lokhu kungase kube ucwaningo lokuqala olugxile kuma-LMICs kulesi sihloko.
Hausa: Wannan yana iya zama binciken farko da ya mayar da hankali a kan LMICs don wannan batu.
Northern Sotho: Tše di ka ba dinyakišišo tša mathomo tšeo di lebeletšego kudu di-LMIC go hlogotaba ye.

English: Previous studies focused on high-income countries and found lower abuse rates (14%) than this study (39%).
Luganda: Okunoonyereza okwayita kwali kutunuulira mawanga agaakula edda era ne kusanga okutulugunyiza kutonoko (14%) okusinga mu kuno (39%).
Yoruba: Àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwadìí tí ó wà nílẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀ gbájúmọ́ àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè tí wọ́n ní ọrọ̀, èyí timwọ́n sí ṣe àwárí ìdá (14%) fún àwọn tí wọ́n ní àdojúkọ èyí tí ó kéré sí ìdá (39%) tí iṣẹ́ ìwadìí yíì ṣe àwárí.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lwangaphambilini lwalugxile emazweni anemali engenayo ephezulu futhi lwathola amazinga okuhlukumeza aphansi (14%) kunalolu cwaningo (39%).
Hausa: Nazarin da suka gabata sun mayar da hankali ne a kan ƙasashe masu samun kuɗin shiga da yawa kuma sun sami yawan cin zarafi kaɗan (14%) fiye da wannan binciken (39%).
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di fetilego di lebeletše kudu dinaga tša letseno la godimo gomme tša hwetša dipalopalo tša tlaišo ya fase (14%) go feta dinyakišišo tše (39%).
Amharic: ቀደም ሲል የተደረጉ ጥናቶች ከፍተኛ-ገቢ ባላቸው አገሮች ላይ ያተኮሩ ሲሆን ከዚህ ጥናት (39%) ያነሱ የጥቃት ምጣኔዎችን (14%) አግኝተዋል።

English: While those previous studies also suggested that childhood abuse causes alcohol use and smoking later in life, this study did not find this in LMICs.
Luganda: Wadde ng’okunoonyereza okwo okwayita era kwalaga nti okutulugunyizibwa mu buto kuvaako okunywa omwenge n’okunywa sigala oluvannyuma, okunoonyereza kuno bino tebyakulaba mu LMICs.
Yoruba: Nígbàtí àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí tíoh ti wà tẹ́lẹ̀ wọ̀nyí dá àbá pé ìlòòdì èwe a máa ṣe okùnfà ìlò otí líle àti fífa àwọn ohun olóro. bó pẹ́ bá yá, iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí kò rí èyí nínú LMICs.
Zulu: Nakuba lezo zincwaningo zangaphambilini ziphinde zaphakamisa ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kubangela ukusetshenziswa kotshwala nokubhema kamuva ekuphileni, lolu cwaningo aluzange likuthole lokhu kuma-LMIC.
Hausa: Duk da yake waɗannan binciken da suka gabata sun kuma nuna cewa cin zarafin yara yana haifar da amfani da barasa da kuma shan taba daga baya a rayuwa, wannan binciken bai sami wannan a cikin LMICs ba.
Northern Sotho: Le ge e le gore dinyakišišo tšeo di fetilego le tšona di šišintše gore tlaišo ya bana di baka tšhomišo ya go nwa bjala le go kgoga motšoko ka moragonyana mo bophelong, dinyakišišo tše ga se tša hwetša se ka go di-LMIC.
Amharic: እነዚያ የቀደሙት ጥናቶች የልጅነት ጥቃት በኋለኛው የህይወት ዘመን አልኮል መጠጣትን እና ማጨስን እንደሚያመጣ ቢጠቁሙም፣ ይህ ጥናት በኤል.ኤም.ኤም.አይ.ሲዎች ውስጥ ይሄንን አላገኘም።

English: These researchers believe there may be cultural and religious factors at play in these countries that reduce alcohol use and smoking.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bano balowooza nti wandibaayo ensonga kinnabuwangwa n’ez’eddiini ezireeta bino mu mawanga gano ebireeta okukendeeza okunywa omwenge n’okunywa sigala okutono.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí yìí gbàgbọ́ pé ó ṣe é ṣe kí àṣà àti ẹ̀sìn ní ipa tí ó ń kó ní àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè tí wọ́n mú ìdẹ́kun bá ìlò ọtí líle àti fífa ohun olóró.
Zulu: Laba bacwaningi bakholelwa ukuthi kungase kube nezinto ezithinta amasiko nezenkolo kulawa mazwe ezinciphisa ukusetshenziswa kotshwala nokubhema.
Hausa: Waɗannan masu binciken sun yi imanin cewa za a iya samun abubuwan al'adu da na addini a cikin waɗannan ƙasashe da suke rage yawan shan barasa da shan taba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba dumela gore go ka be go na le mabaka a setš le a sedumedi ka mo dinageng tše ao a fokotšago tšomišobošaedi ya bjala le ya go kgoga.
Amharic: እነዚህ ተመራማሪዎች በእነዚህ አገሮች የአልኮል አጠቃቀምን እና ማጨስን የሚቀንሱ ባህላዊ እና ሃይማኖታዊ ምክንያቶች ሊኖሩ እንደሚችሉ ያምናሉ።

English: These researchers say that their findings may not be valid for these countries as a whole because the Evidence for Better Lives Study did not randomly choose mother-baby pairs.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bano bagamba nti okunoonyereza kwabwe kuyinza obutaba kutuufu mu mawanga gano okutwaliza awamu kubanga okunoonyereza kwa Evidence for Better Lives Study tekwalonda migogo gya bamaama mu ngeri yakulabiraawo.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí sọ pé ó ṣe é ṣe kí ìwádìí àwọn má kún ojú òṣùwọ̀n fún gbogbo àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè wọ̀nyí nítorí èrí fún iṣẹ́ ìwadìí Better Lives kò kàn ṣà dédé mú ìya-olómọ.
Zulu: Laba bacwaningi bathi lokho abakutholile kungase kungasebenzi kulawa mazwe ewonke ngenxa yokuthi i-Evidence for Better Lives Study ayizange ikhethe ngokungahleliwe umama-ingane ngababili.
Hausa: Waɗannan masu binciken sun ce binciken nasu ba zai yi tasiri ba ga waɗannan ƙasashe gabaɗaya ba saboda Hujjojin Nazari na Rayuwa mai Kyau bai zaɓi uwa-da-jariri ba bisa ƙa’ida ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ba bolela gore dikutollo tša bona di ka no se nepagale ka mo dinageng tše ka botlalo ka lebaka la gore Dinyakišišo tša Bohlatse bja Bophelo bjo Bokaone ga se tša kgetha diphere tša mma le lesea ka sewelo.
Amharic: ማስረጃ ለተሻሉ ህይወቶች ጥናት የእናት-ህፃን ጥንዶችን በዘፈቀደ ስላልመረጠ ግኝቶቻቸው በአጠቃላይ ለእነዚህ ሀገራት ተቀባይነት ላይኖረው ይችላል ይላሉ እነዚህ ተመራማሪዎች።

English: For logistical reasons, they chose mothers that matched specific requirements, like being able to regularly visit the same hospital.
Luganda: Olw’ensonga z’ebikozesebwa, baalonda bamaama batuukiriza ebyetaago ebimu, gamba ng’obusobi bw’okugendanga ku ddwaliro.
Yoruba: Fún àwọn ìdí pàtàkì, wọ́n ṣe àṣàyàn àwọn ìyá tí ó bá ohun tí wọ́n ń wá ni pàtó mú, bíi kí ó má awá sí ilé ìwòsàn déédé.
Zulu: Ngenxa yezizathu zokuhleleka, bakhethe omama abahambisana nezidingo ezithile, njengokukwazi ukuvakashela isibhedlela esisodwa njalo.
Hausa: Domin dalilai na shiri, sun zaɓi iyaye mata waɗanda suka dace da takamaiman buƙatu, kamar samun damar ziyartar asibiti akai-akai.
Northern Sotho: Mabakeng a kamaganyo, ba ile ba kgetha bomma bao ba bego ba nyalelana le dinyakwa tše itšego, go swana le go kgona go etela sepetlele se tee kgafetšakgafetša.
Amharic: ለአቅርቦታዊ ምክንያቶች፣ ተመሳሳይ ሆስፒታል አዘውትሮ መጎብኘት እንደመቻል ያሉ፣ የተወሰኑ መስፈርቶችን የሚያሟሉ እናቶችን መርጠዋል።

English: They also said that the answers to questions may not have been completely honest.
Luganda: Era baagamba nti ebyokuddamu bwabwe ku bibuuzo biyinza okuba nga tebyalimu mazima bulungi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ pé gbogbo àwọn ìdáhùn wọn sí àwọn ìbéèrè lè má jẹ́ òtítọ́ tán yányán.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi izimpendulo zemibuzo kungenzeka azilona iqiniso ngokuphelele.
Hausa: Sun kuma ce amsoshin tambayoyin suna iya zama ba gaskiya ba ne.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gape gore dikarabo tša dipotšišo di ka be di se na bonnete ka botlalo.
Amharic: ለጥያቄዎች የሚሰጠው መልስ ሙሉ በሙሉ የሚታመን ላይሆን እንደሚችልም ተናግረዋል።

English: No one verified them, and mothers may not have wanted to share traumatic experiences.
Luganda: Tewali muntu n’omu yabyekaliriza kulaba oba nga bituufu, era bamaama bandiba nga tebaayagala kwogera ku bitiisa bye baayitamu.
Yoruba: Kò sí ẹ̀ni tí ó ṣe ìwádìí rẹ̀, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, ó ṣe é ṣe kí ìyá má fẹ́ láti sọ òtítọ́ nípa àwọn ìdánwò tí ó là kọjá.
Zulu: Akekho oziqinisekisile, futhi omama kungenzeka ukuthi bebengafuni ukwabelana ngezinto ezibuhlungu.
Hausa: Babu wanda ya tabbatar da su, kuma iyaye mata ba za su so su bayyana abubuwan ban tausayi da suka faru ba.
Northern Sotho: Ga a gona yo a ilego a  di lekola, gomme bomma ba ka no ba be ba sa nyake go faa ka maitemogelo a bona a kgatelelo ye kgolo ya menagano.
Amharic: ማንም አላረጋገጠላቸውም፣ እናቶች አሰቃቂ ገጠመኞችን ማካፈል ላይፈልጉ ይችላሉ።

English: The researchers suggested that more studies should be done on LMICs, and that future work focus on how severe, long, and regular abuse was rather than the types of abuse.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bateesa nti okunoonyereza okulala kulina okukolebwa mu LMICs, era nti okunoonyereza okujja kulina okutunuulira ku bubi, ebbanga n’olutetenzi lw’okutulugunyizibwa mu kifo ky’ebika by’okutulugunya.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí gbàá ní ìmọ̀ràn pé kí iṣẹ́ ìwadìí túbọ̀ wáyé lórí LMICs, àti pé kí àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí ọjọ́ iwájú gbájúmọ́ àwọn ìjìyà tí ó burújáì, tí ó pẹ́ àti èyí tí ó wọ́pọ̀, jú irúfẹ́ ìjìyà lọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphakamise ukuthi ucwaningo olwengeziwe kufanele lwenziwe kuma-LMIC, nokuthi umsebenzi wesikhathi esizayo ugxile ekutheni ukuhlukunyezwa kwakunzima, isikhathi eside kangakanani futhi kwakuvamile kangakanani kunezinhlobo zokuhlukumeza.
Hausa: Masu bincikne sun nuna cewa ya kamata a yi ƙarin nazari a kan LMICs, kuma aikin nan gaba ya mayar da hankali a kan yadda cin zarafi mai tsanani da tsawo da kuma na yau da kullum ya kasance maimakon nau’o’in cin zarafi.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba šišinya gore dinyakišišo tše dingwe di swanetše go dirwa ka ga di-LMIC, le gore mošomo wa ka moso o swanetše go nepiša kudu ka fao tlaišo e bilego ye šoro ka gona, ye telele bjang le gore e bile kgafetšakgafetša bjang.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በኤል.ኤም.ኤም.አይ.ሲዎች ላይ ተጨማሪ ጥናቶች መደረግ እንዳለባቸው ጠቁመዋል፣ እና ወደፊት ስራው የሚያተኩረው ከጥቃት አይነቶች ይልቅ ምን ያህል ከባድ፣ ረጅም፣ እና መደበኛ ጥቃት እንደሆነ ላይ ነው።

English: These researchers were from South Africa, Ghana, Pakistan, Philippines, Jamaica, UK, Australia, Sri Lanka, Romania, Vietnam, and Switzerland.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bano baali bava mu South Afirika, Ghana, Pakisitaani, Philippines, Jamaica, Bungereza, Australia, Sri Lanka, Romania, Vietnam, ne Switzerland.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí wá láti  South Africa, Ghana, Pakistan, Philippines, Jamaica, UK, Australia, Sri Lanka, Romania, Vietnam, àti Switzerland.
Zulu: Laba bacwaningi bebevela eNingizimu Afrika, e-Ghana, e-Pakistan, e-Philippines, e-Jamaica, e-UK, e-Australia, e-Sri Lanka, e-Romania, e-Vietnam, nase-Switzerland.
Hausa: Waɗannan masu binciken sun fito ne daga Afirka ta Kudu da Ghana da Pakistan da Philippines da Jamaica da UK da Australia da Sri Lanka da Romania da Vietnam da kuma Switzerland.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba etšwa ka Afrika Borwa, Ghana, Pakistan, Philippines, Jamaica, UK, Australia, Sri Lanka, Romania, Vietnam, le Switzerland.
Amharic: እነዚህ ተመራማሪዎች ከደቡብ አፍሪካ፣ ጋና፣ ፓኪስታን፣ ፊሊፒንስ፣ ጃማይካ፣ ዩኬ፣ አውስትራሊያ፣ ስሪላንካ፣ ሮማኒያ፣ ቬትናም እና ስዊዘርላንድ ነበሩ።

English: Their work is especially relevant to Africa as it has many LMICs.
Luganda: Okusinga ennyo okunoonyereza kwabwe kwamugaso nnyo eri Afirika kubanga kulina amawanga mangi ga-LMICs.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ wọn ní pàtó ṣe pàtàkì sí ilẹ̀ Africa bẹ́ẹ̀ sì ní ó ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ LMICs.
Zulu: Umsebenzi wabo ubaluleke kakhulu e-Afrika njengoba inama-LMIC amaningi.
Hausa: Ayyukansu suna da mahimmanci, musamman ga nahiyar Afirka saboda tana da LMICs da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Mošomo wa bona o tloga o le maleba go Afrika ka ge o na le di-LMIC tše ntši.
Amharic: ይሄ ስራ ብዙ ኤል.ኤም.ኤም.አይ.ሲዎች ስላሉት በተለይም ለአፍሪካ ጠቃሚ ነው።
